title: Water Shutoff Safety
description: Explains main, fixture, and street shutoffs, how to find yours, and how gate, ball, and globe valves work. Covers shutting off and restoring water, burst pipes and unknown leaks, water heater shutdown and using it as an emergency supply, fixture shutoffs, and valve maintenance.
shortDescription: Find and close your main valve, handle burst pipes, and drain the heater
author: OfflineOwl Contributors
